import click
import time
import fnmatch
from pathlib import Path
from watchdog.observers import Observer
from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler

class PatternHandler(FileSystemEventHandler):
    def __init__(self, pattern: str):
        self.pattern = pattern
        self.events: list[dict] = []

    def on_any_event(self, event):
        if event.is_directory:
            return
        if self.pattern and not fnmatch.fnmatch(Path(event.src_path).name, self.pattern):
            return
        entry = {"type": event.event_type, "path": event.src_path, "ts": time.time()}
        self.events.append(entry)
        click.echo(f"[{event.event_type}] {event.src_path}")

@click.command()
@click.option("--dir", "watch_dir", type=click.Path(exists=True), default=".", help="Directory to watch")
@click.option("--pattern", default="*", help="Glob pattern to filter files")
@click.option("--interval", type=float, default=1.0, help="Polling interval in seconds")
def main(watch_dir: str, pattern: str, interval: float):
    """Monitor a directory for file changes."""
    handler = PatternHandler(pattern)
    observer = Observer()
    observer.schedule(handler, watch_dir, recursive=True)
    observer.start()
    click.echo(f"Watching {watch_dir} for '{pattern}' (interval={interval}s)")
    try:
        while True:
            time.sleep(interval)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        observer.stop()
    observer.join()

if __name__ == "__main__":
